caption:
AI won't plan your year-end for you. But it's a very good thinking partner.

These are the four prompts I use to turn a messy to-do list into a calm plan for the last weeks of the year. Copy them into any AI assistant and make them yours.

Save this and try one tonight. ☕

#aitools #aiprompts #productivity #solopreneur #worksmarter #aiforbusiness #planning

✦ AI-generated creator

slides.title: 4 AI prompts for a calm end of the year

slides.heading: The brain-dump
slides.body: "Here's everything on my mind. Group it into themes and tell me what can wait until January."

slides.heading: The reality check
slides.body: "I have eight weeks and about 20 focused hours a week. Which of these goals fit? Be honest."

slides.heading: The weekly plan
slides.body: "Turn my top three goals into one small, concrete step for each week until December 31."

slides.heading: The year in review
slides.body: "Ask me ten questions to reflect on this year: what worked, what drained me, what I want more of."

slides.quote: Let AI do the sorting, so you can do the deciding.
slides.author: Arielle
